An attacker could exploit this via crafted HTTP requests that access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and supply a crafted file-path or stream parameter during data import processing

articles.title: GHSA: libp2p: gossipsub creates a permanent topics-map entry per distinct subscription with no cap in the default config
articles.summary:
### Summary
A single gossipsub peer can grow a node's `topics` map without bound by flooding subscription RPCs, because the default configuration has no global, per-peer, or topic-length cap and peer scoring does not penalise subscription volume. The peer is never greylisted, so the growth continues toward OOM.

articles.summary:

A remote peer can stall a js-libp2p node's entire event loop for ~4–5 seconds per connection (and transiently allocate ~2 GB) by sending a ~15-byte crafted `publicKey` inside an Identify message. articles.title: CVE-2026-82150 — CVSS 8.0
articles.summary: Dell SupportAssist OS Recovery, versions prior to 5.5.16.3, contain an Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker with adjacent network access could potentially exploit this vulnerability to bypass manifest signature validation, potentially leading to execution of unauthorized code with elevated privileges.

articles.title: CVE-2026-82149 — CVSS 5.9
articles.summary: Dell SupportAssist OS Recovery, versions prior to 5.5.16.3, contain an External Control of System or Configuration Setting vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker with adjacent network access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Elevation of Privileges.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130874 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: Seerr before 3.5.2 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust disk space through unnormalized /imageproxy cache keys. Attackers can request the same TMDB image using many equivalent dot-segment path spellings, storing unlimited duplicate copies that fill the shared SQLite configuration volume and break logins and requests.

articles.summary: linkdotnet Blog through 17.1 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users by passing unvalidated redirectUri values on the Login and Logout pages. articles.title: CVE-2026-130870 — CVSS 7.4
articles.summary: ClearFlask before 2.7.3 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows any account holding an invitation ID to accept it regardless of invited email. Attackers who obtain a forwarded or shared invitation link can redeem it via accountAcceptInvitationAdmin or accountSignupAdmin to become project administrators.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130868 — CVSS 7.4
articles.summary: GreaterWMS through 2.1.54 contains a predictable authentication token vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge openid tokens by recomputing an unsalted MD5 hash of username and registration timestamp. articles.title: CVE-2026-130867 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: GreaterWMS through 2.1.54 contains an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in the css, js, statics and fonts routes in greaterwms/views.py, which concatenate raw request.path_info without normalization. Attackers can send URL-encoded ../ sequences to read db.sqlite3 and obtain user openid tokens, enabling impersonation of any account.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130866 — CVSS 6.1
articles.summary: Pastefy 7.2.1 before 7.2.7 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in MermaidViewer.vue that passes attacker-supplied %%{init}%% directives to mermaid.mermaidAPI.updateSiteConfig(). Unauthenticated attackers can create Mermaid or Markdown pastes setting securityLevel to loose with a permissive dompurifyConfig to steal viewers' API session keys and act on their accounts.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130863 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary: ArtisanCloud PowerX through 1.0.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the IAM role management API that allows authenticated tenant members to escalate privileges. Attackers holding even the lowest built-in role can call the permissions/grant-ids, permissions/grant, or bind/member routes to grant permissions or bind privileged roles, gaining tenant administrative access.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130862 — CVSS 5.4
articles.summary: BeikeShop through 2.0.0.32 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered customers to inject script by submitting an unsanitized RMA comment rendered unescaped in mail templates. Attackers can submit a return request with malicious script saved to mail_logs.content, executing in an administrator's browser session when they view the Mail Logs entry.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130861 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary: UrlHub before 1.20.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to create accounts via the POST /admin/user/store route because role:admin middleware only covers view and create actions. Attackers, including self-registered users, can submit a request with role=admin to create an administrator account and gain full administrative control.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130857 — CVSS 8.3
articles.summary: EveryDocs Core before 1.6.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to access other users' records through unscoped Model.find(params[:id]) lookups in multiple controllers. Self-registered attackers can enumerate sequential ids to read, modify, or delete other users' documents and stored files, and rename or delete their folders, tags and people.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130856 — CVSS 9.8
articles.summary: 53AIHub before 0.5.5 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to reinitialize installed instances by calling the public POST /api/init endpoint. Attackers can reset an existing account's password, assign the top creator role, and obtain an access token to take over accounts and use admin-only API routes.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130855 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary: Bonsai through 6.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated Editor users to access admin pages because AdminAuthHandler accepts both Administrator and Editor roles. Attackers can use UsersController and DynamicConfigController to reset administrator passwords, promote accounts to Administrator, and change global settings to take over the instance.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130854 — CVSS 5.4
articles.summary: AudioBookRequest 1.9.0 through 2.0.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to inject script through manual book request fields due to disabled Jinja2 autoescaping. articles.title: CVE-2026-130853 — CVSS 7.2
articles.summary: Nexterm through 1.2.2-BETA contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows users with permissions.manage to gain unauthorized permissions because addGroupMember and setUserGroups lack the grantsBeyondCaller check. Attackers can add their own account to custom groups via the group membership endpoints to inherit permissions like users.impersonate and settings.backup.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130852 — CVSS 5.3
articles.summary: wishthis through 1.2.3 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the PUT branch of src/api/wishes.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify wish URLs across all users. Attackers who know a wish link from a public wishlist can supply wish_url_current and wish_url_proposed parameters to redirect owners and gift-givers to attacker-controlled URLs.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130851 — CVSS 7.1
articles.summary: wishthis through 1.2.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in User::ownsWishlist() that allows authenticated users to modify other users' wishes and wishlists. Attackers can supply sequential wish_id and wishlist_id values to the wishes and wishlists API handlers to edit wishes, add wishes, or rename and delete wishlists.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130850 — CVSS 5.4
articles.summary: LaraCollab through 0.18.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated client-role users to inject script by posting unsanitized task comments rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Attackers can post malicious comments that execute when users, including administrators, open the task or view dashboard recent comments, allowing actions in their session.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130848 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary: Dolibarr ERP CRM through 24.0.3 contains a code injection vulnerability in Website::importWebSite() that allows website editors without PHP permission to execute code by importing templates. Attackers can import a template zip whose javascript.js.php contains PHP code, which the public javascript.js.php endpoint includes, executing code as the web server user.

articles.title: CVE-2026-130847 — CVSS 7.2
articles.summary: Dolibarr ERP CRM before 24.0.2 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the Users REST API put() method that allows non-admin API users to set administrator passwords. Authenticated users with user modification and password rights can send a PUT request to the users endpoint with a chosen pass value for a SuperAdmin account and then log in as that administrator.
